skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the roles, significance, and methodologies in land administration science.
Comprehend the components of the land administration system.
Understand the basic functions of land administration.
Understand the content of land management models (land administration models).
Relate issues within the Vietnamese land administration system.
Identify components within the Vietnamese land administration system (management models).
Explain the basic contents of the Vietnamese land administration system.
Analyze the basic functions of the Vietnamese land administration system.
Be proactive in learning, research, and group work.
Be proactive in seeking and selecting topics and reference materials during the learning process.
Be proactive in presenting research results.
